blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Monday vowed to improve nurse-to-patient ratios, fill vacant positions, and provide more opportunities for Filipino nurses. He made the commitment during the Philippine Nurses Association (PNA), Inc.’s 2026 National Annual Convention, which coincided with its 104th Foundation Anniversary and the 69th Nurses’ Week Celebration. READ: Philippines nurse exodus leaves hospitals short-staffed In his speech, Marcos recognized the vital role Filipino nurses play in providing health care not only in the Philippines but also worldwide. “Your contributions deserve our recognition and our continued commitment to advance the welfare and professional development of nurses.
